messages.subject: Sustainability & ESG Executive | External Affairs, Stakeholder & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Farrell Associates Team,

Your senior search work across sustainability, ESG and responsible business aligns closely with my leadership background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where sustainability strategy must connect business performance, regulators, communities and long-term stakeholder value. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
